blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Both people and companies pay taxes, but in different ways. An individual pays income tax on their salary. They also pay a sales tax every time they shop.

A company pays more kinds of taxes. It pays corporate tax on its profit. It collects sales tax from customers. It also pays payroll taxes on the salaries of its employees.

So when a product is sold, several taxes move at once. The customer pays sales tax. The company pays corporate tax on the profit. And the salaries behind that product carry income and payroll taxes too. Every sale, in a way, supports a little bit of public life.

items.q: What tax does an individual pay on their salary?
items.why: "An individual pays income tax on their salary."

items.q: Who collects the sales tax from customers?
items.why: "It collects sales tax from customers" — a empresa coleta o imposto sobre vendas.

items.q: The text suggests that a company pays…
options: the same taxes as a person
more kinds of taxes than a person
items.why: Inferência: o indivíduo paga dois impostos; a empresa paga três (corporate, sales, payroll).

items.q: "Every sale supports a little bit of public life." This suggests that taxes…
items.why: Inferência: o imposto de cada venda ajuda a sustentar a vida pública (serviços do país).

items.q: When one product is sold, how many taxes move?
items.why: "several taxes move at once."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver explicando ao novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, come here and look at this. A customer buys a product for one hundred pounds. It looks very simple, right? Just one sale. But four different taxes move at the same time.

First, the customer pays a sales tax on the price. Our company does not keep that money. We only collect it and then send it to the government.

Second, the company makes a small profit on that sale. On that profit, we pay corporate tax. That one is our tax, not the customer's.

Third and fourth, think about the people. The person who made the product has a salary. On that salary, they pay income tax. And the company pays a payroll tax on the same salary. So the employee pays one tax, and the company pays another.

So one small sale, one hundred pounds, quietly touches four taxes. A person tax, a company tax, and two taxes on the salary behind the product. That is why we always say that every sale supports a little bit of public life.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How much does the customer pay for the product?
items.why: "A customer buys a product for one hundred pounds."

items.q: What does the company do with the sales tax?
options: It collects it and sends it to the government
It gives it back to the customer
It pays it to the employee
items.why: "We only collect it and send it to the government."

items.q: Which tax does the company pay on its profit?
items.why: "On that profit, we pay corporate tax."

items.q: Oliver says two taxes touch the salary. This suggests that a salary is…
options: taxed by both the worker and the company
items.why: Inferência: o funcionário paga income tax e a empresa paga payroll tax sobre o mesmo salário.

items.q: Why does Oliver explain all this to the junior?
options: To show that a simple sale is not so simple
To ask for a bigger salary
items.why: Inferência: ele mostra que uma venda de £100 esconde quatro impostos ao mesmo tempo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Every employee in the shop pays income tax." An employee is…
options: a person who works for a company
items.why: Employee = funcionário, a pessoa que trabalha para a empresa.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The company pays a ___ on the salaries of its workers."
items.why: Payroll tax = imposto sobre a folha de pagamento, ligado aos salários.

items.q: "She likes to shop on Saturday." To shop means to…
items.why: To shop = comprar, ir às compras.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "After work, he gets his ___ at the end of the month."
items.why: Salary = salário, o dinheiro que o funcionário recebe pelo trabalho.

items.q: "The store makes one sale every minute." A sale is…
items.why: Sale = venda, quando um produto é vendido.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The company has to pay taxes every year." To pay taxes means to…
items.why: Pay taxes = pagar impostos ao governo.

items.q: "The shop sold out of that product." It means the product is…
items.why: Sold out = esgotado, tudo vendido.

items.q: "We hand over the sales tax to the government." To hand over means to…
items.why: Hand over = entregar, passar algo para outra pessoa.

items.q: "Let me break it down for you." To break it down means to…
items.why: Break it down = explicar por partes, de forma simples.

items.q: "The customer picked up two products." To pick up means to…
items.why: Pick up = pegar, apanhar (aqui, comprar/levar um produto).
